newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch govt plan huge armoured vehicle order.
newsitem.headline: Dutch govt plan huge armoured vehicle order.

text.p: The Dutch Defence Ministry said on Friday it was planning an extensive phased order of armoured vehicles with a total worth of 5.6 billion guilders.
The ministry said in a statement that for the first tranche of 210 vehicles it would join the German/French/British GTK cooperation project.
A ministry spokesman said GTK was a three-nation cooperation which was looking to develop a new armoured personnel carrier for France, Germany and Britain.

The spokesman said the Netherlands was aiming to replace 1,600 of its existing armoured personnel carriers with 1,340 new vehicles, adding that armed forces reorganisations would make for a lower total of new vehicles.
The statement said the Italian Centauro 8x8 vehicle had not been chosen because the GTK project suited the Dutch needs better for "operational, political and industrial reasons".
The statement said the order was needed to replace the existing vehicles, some of which were up to 40 years old.

The first 210 will be replaced from the year 2005. By the end of 1997 or the beginning of 1998 the GTK project will decide which industrial consortium will receive the order to develop prototypes for the vehicles.
